en: A commemorative postcard featuring a historic black‑and‑white street scene overlaid with small color photos of landmarks along Calea Victoriei in Bucharest. The caption celebrates 300 years of the street formerly called Podul Mogoșoaiei. Landmarks pictured include the Romanian Athenaeum, the CEC Palace, the former Royal Palace/National Museum of Art, and Kretzulescu Church.
